findings.rationale: The jump host’s administrative SSH port is open to every routable address, creating a broadly reachable interactive surface inside the trust boundary.
The in-account principal can assume the AdministratorAccess role, turning role assumption into a direct path to account-wide privilege escalation.
The internet-facing jump host chains into the assumable administrator role, producing an end-to-end path from unauthenticated network reachability to privileged identity.
A principal with the wildcard identity policy can read the public-read bucket, so the open identity control compounds into a direct data-disclosure path across two fixtures.
The policy grants Action=* on Resource=*, leaving no effective privilege boundary for any attached principal.
